versos.texto_bv: Ele consumiu minha carne e minha pele; quebrou meus ossos.
versos.traducao_literal: Consumiu minha carne e minha pele, quebrou meus ossos.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): O verbo 'consumiu' diverge do verbo 'envelhecer', usado de forma convergente por NTLH, ARA e NVIPT para o mesmo verbo hebraico. — evidência: NTLH: "Deus fez envelhecer a minha carne e a minha pele"; ARA: "Fez envelhecer a minha carne e a minha pele"; NVIPT: "Fez que a minha pele e a minha carne envelhecessem". A traducao_literal ancora "Consumiu minha carne e minha pele".

kjv.texto: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.

vizinhos.3: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.
vizinhos.5: He hath builded against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.

web.texto: My flesh and my skin has he made old; he has broken my bones.

vizinhos.3: Surely against me he turns his hand again and again all the day.
vizinhos.5: He has built against me, and surrounded me with gall and travail.
